text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT AND BARLEY SALE - The Japanese Food Agency said Thursday it bought 180,000 tonnes of wheat -- 60,000 U.S., 60,000 Canadian and 60,000 Australian -- plus 20,000 tonnes of Australian barley at its weekly tender, all for September shipment.
WHEAT SALE - Algeria bought 75,000 tonnes of French soft wheat for April delivery onwards under a Coface export credit at about $165 per tonne, cost and freight, European grain exporters said.

- The Korea Feed Association's (KFA) office in Pusan has bought 35,000 tonnes of Argentine wheat at $141.50 per tonne C&F through private negotiation, traders said on Thursday. Arrival was slated by May 25 to the southeastern port city of Pusan.
DURUM SALE - Tunisia purchased four lots of 25,000 tonnes each of optional durum wheat for March-May shipment at $198.85 to $186.00 per tonne C&F at a tender on Thursday, traders said.
SOYBEAN SALE - Private exporters reported to Agriculture Department export sales of 100,000 tonnes white wheat to Pakistan for delivery during the 1996/97 marketing year.
CORN SALE - Taiwan's Members Feed Industry group bought 54,000 tonnes of Argentine corn from Toepfer at a tender on Thursday, traders said.

SUNOIL SALE - The Commodity Credit Corp of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it had purchased 3,000 tonnes of U.S. sunflowerseed oil from ADM Bulk Oils for export to Mozambique, priced at $509.60 per tonne, FOB New Orleans.
SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan BSPA's Taichung Division will tender on Friday for one 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. soybeans for March/April shipment, traders said.
CORN TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission on Wednesday invited tenders for the supply of 18,000 tonnes of maize, with shipment in March 1997. Tenders close on February 25.

CORN, RICE, CORN/SOY BLEND TENDER - The Commodity Credit Corp of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it was seeking a total of 32,380 tonnes U.S. corn, rice and corn/soy blend for shipment to North Korea. The deal included 5,000 tonnes of corn-soy blend, 20,780 tonnes of yellow corn and 6,600 tonnes milled rice. Delivery at U.S. port was slated before April 1. Offers were due on February 25.

WHEAT TENDER - The CCC said it seeks a total of 10,530 tonnes U.S. hard red wheat under its export program to Bangladesh. The wheat was divided into two offers. One was for 5,870 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat and the other was for 4,660 tonnes HRW or hard red spring wheat. Shipment period for both was for March 15-April 10. Offers were due on February 26.

MARKET TALK - Vietnam's export rice market was quiet on Thursday as traders awaited final confirmation of a rice deal with the Philippines and as state media remained silent on the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.
... The New South Wales division of the Australian Wheat Board set a new record by exporting more than one million tonnes of wheat in February, state manager Ted Laskie said in a statement.
... Several U.S. exporters said they expect Lebanon to tender early next week for 35,000 tonnes of optional origin hard wheat for March shipment.
